title: Unidirectional Layered Monorepo Architecture in AI Harnesses
context: Monorepo architectural partitioning across CLI, TUI, background daemons, and client SDKs in AI agent harnesses.
distilled_learning: Enforcing a strict unidirectional acyclic dependency graph (Schema -> Core & Protocol -> Server -> Client/CLI/SDK) prevents client runtime and presentation layers from leaking core engine dependencies, database credentials, or server secrets.

claims.assertion: Acyclic layering Schema -> Core & Protocol -> Server -> Client/CLI/SDK strictly prevents client runtime and presentation layers from leaking core engine dependencies, database credentials, or server secrets.
